_comment: KZ-602 — single source of truth for what the i18n RU-leak guard (tests/guard/) is allowed to skip. Not hardcoded in the guard so the allowlist can shrink without touching test code. Mirrors the frontend's scripts/i18n-exclude.json.

always_raw_fields._comment: Response keys that legitimately carry Russian (or mixed) text forever — official names, raw scraped catalog data, machine keys. Not UI copy, never translated. Same rule as the FE KZ-206 'backend data' allowlist.

catalog_temp_allowlist._comment: Was a TEMPORARY allowlist for free-text catalog descriptions served in Russian until KZ-504/505 backfilled description_i18n['kk']. KZ-505 is done (all 2399 universities + 1398 programs translated + native-reviewed, applied 2026-09-08), so this is now EMPTY. test_guard_config_temp_allowlist_is_only_kz504_pending_fields asserts it stays empty — a re-added key means a RU-leak is being hidden.

ru_marker_words._comment: Word-level (not substring) markers that appear in Russian prose but not in literary Kazakh. Used to flag a Russian leak in a field that is supposed to be fully kk. Kept short and unambiguous to avoid false positives.
